title: Phi-4-Mini-Reasoning: Exploring the Limits of Small Reasoning Language Models in Math
paper_type_zh: 小模型推理技术报告与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 审计数学推理蒸馏、偏好学习和 RLVR 披露边界的读者
one_line: Phi-4-Mini-Reasoning documents a four-stage math-reasoning pipeline over about 10M rollouts, with correct-trace distillation, rejected-rollout DPO, and final-answer RLVR, but releases weights rather than the training data or verifier stack.
Phi-4-Mini-Reasoning 报告了合成 CoT、Rollout DPO 与答案可验证 RL 的四阶段数学推理配方，但未发布完整数据、verifier 或审计资产。
why: It enables a stage-by-stage disclosure audit of data objects and feedback contracts for a 3.8B reasoning model, including a visible mismatch between the paper and later model-card descriptions of trajectory provenance.
inclusion_reason: An official small-model report that exposes a four-stage post-training sequence, named data resources, rollout scale, preference construction, answer-level verification, and RL stabilization choices while leaving the training records, verifier, and audit manifests unreleased.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Phi-4-Mini-Reasoning asks whether a 3.8B model can acquire long-form mathematical reasoning through a coordinated post-training pipeline rather than a single small distillation set. The paper motivates this question with two observations: DeepSeek-R1-style distillation can transfer reasoning to small models, but detailed recipes are often missing; and naively fine-tuning Phi-4-Mini on LIMO or s1K lowers the paper's reported AIME 2024, MATH-500, and GPQA Diamond results relative to the base model.

For this atlas, the decision boundary is disclosure rather than leaderboard rank. The relevant data objects are math questions, long-CoT responses, verification outcomes, difficulty and domain attributes, correct-over-incorrect preference pairs, and online RL rollouts. The relevant feedback interfaces are a math-verification tool, GPT-4o-mini rechecking and difficulty labels, DPO preferences, and binary final-answer rewards. The report is useful because it exposes these layers and their approximate scale, while a complete training corpus, source manifest, verifier implementation, and contamination audit remain unavailable.

Phi-4-Mini-Reasoning 研究的不是用一个小型蒸馏集微调，而是通过协调的后训练流水线，让 38 亿参数模型获得长程数学推理能力。论文给出两点动机：DeepSeek-R1 式蒸馏可以把推理能力迁移到小模型，但详细配方往往缺失；在 Phi-4-Mini 上直接使用 LIMO 或 s1K 微调，论文报告的 AIME 2024、MATH-500 与 GPQA Diamond 结果反而低于基础模型。

对本图谱而言，收录边界是数据披露而非排行榜名次。相关数据对象包括数学问题、长 CoT 响应、验证结果、难度与领域属性、正确相对错误的偏好对，以及在线 RL rollout；反馈接口包括数学验证工具、GPT-4o-mini 复核与难度标注、DPO 偏好和二元最终答案奖励。该报告的价值在于公开了这些层次及其大致规模，但完整训练语料、来源清单、verifier 实现和污染审计仍不可得。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is a four-stage sequence tailored to a small base model. First, Phi-4-Mini performs packed causal-language-model mid-training over the full accepted long-CoT collection. Second, unpacked SFT uses a compact subset described as diverse and above college difficulty. Third, Rollout DPO reuses rejected generations: GPT-4o-mini keeps questions labeled high-school level or above, correct rollouts become preferred responses, and incorrect rollouts become dispreferred responses. Fourth, online RL optimizes final-answer correctness while adding prompt selection, reward-group rebalancing, and temperature annealing to address small-model instability.

The construction object is therefore not one homogeneous dataset. It is a lineage of source questions and existing annotations, DeepSeek-R1 trajectories where traces are missing, verification and descriptive labels, selected correct traces, preference pairs, and fresh RL groups. The feedback contract is mixed: programmatic answer checking is supplemented by a proprietary LLM recheck, preferences are answer-outcome-derived, and RL receives an answer-level scalar signal. This supports classification as distillation, preference learning, and RLVR in the frontier-report disclosure ledger, but not as process supervision or a fully open recipe.

核心贡献是一套面向小型基础模型的四阶段顺序。第一阶段，Phi-4-Mini 在完整的已接受长 CoT 集合上，以 packing 方式进行因果语言模型中训练；第二阶段，使用论文所称兼具多样性且难度高于大学水平的紧凑子集，以 non-packing 方式完成 SFT；第三阶段，Rollout DPO 复用被拒生成，GPT-4o-mini 保留被判为高中及以上难度的问题，把正确 rollout 作为 preferred response、错误 rollout 作为 dispreferred response；第四阶段，在线 RL 优化最终答案正确性，并通过提示选择、奖励组再平衡和温度退火缓解小模型训练不稳定。

因此，构造对象并非一个同质数据集，而是一条谱系：来源问题与既有标注、缺少轨迹时由 DeepSeek-R1 生成的轨迹、验证结果与描述性标签、筛选后的正确轨迹、偏好对，以及新鲜 RL 采样组。其反馈合同是混合式的：程序化答案检查由专有 LLM 复核补充，偏好由答案结果派生，RL 接收答案级标量信号。这足以支持在“前沿报告与数据披露账本”中将其归为蒸馏、偏好学习和 RLVR，但不足以称为过程监督或完全开放配方。

title: Method
方法
html:
Section 4 names eight public resources: AquaRAT (98K), Ape210K (210K), MetaMathQA (395K), MathInstruct (262K), TAL-SCQ5K (5K), OpenR1-Math (220K), Bespoke-Stratos-17k (17K), and OpenThoughts-114K (114K), plus several in-house seed datasets. Existing reasoning annotations are used directly when present. Otherwise only the question is retained and DeepSeek-R1 (671B) samples approximately eight CoT responses. The report totals about 10M rollouts across 1.6M samples. A math-verification tool checks verifiable answers; because it can reject complex correct solutions, GPT-4o-mini rechecks initially incorrect rollouts. Records are also labeled for domain, difficulty, and repetitive patterns. Exact mixture weights, item-level provenance, prompts, yields, and licenses are unknown.

Mid-training consumes the full constructed set and retains correct responses through rejection sampling. It uses packed 16K sequences, batch size 128, learning rate 1e-5, five epochs, and 0.1 warmup. SFT selects an undisclosed compact subset above college difficulty and uses unpacked 20K sequences with the same reported batch, learning-rate, epoch, and warmup settings. DPO uses high-school-or-harder questions, correct/incorrect pairs, 16K sequences, learning rate 5e-7, and one epoch; pair counts and selection yields are not reported.

For RL, the paper discusses GRPO and reports three stability problems: within-group positive responses spanning roughly 12K-20K tokens, zero gradients when group rewards are uniform, and an exploration/evaluation temperature mismatch. Its recipe samples several candidate prompts and keeps those with relatively uniform response lengths; oversamples difficult prompts, retains all positives, and samples an equal number of negatives; filters overly easy groups above an example 50% accuracy threshold; and anneals temperature from 1.0 to 0.6 over the first half of training. RL uses learning rate 5e-7 and 25K sequences. The final RL algorithm code, rollout-group size, prompt pool, verifier implementation, and remaining optimizer settings are not released.

第 4 节列出八个公开资源：AquaRAT（98K）、Ape210K（210K）、MetaMathQA（395K）、MathInstruct（262K）、TAL-SCQ5K（5K）、OpenR1-Math（220K）、Bespoke-Stratos-17k（17K）与 OpenThoughts-114K（114K），另有若干内部种子数据集。来源已有推理标注时直接使用；否则只保留问题，由 DeepSeek-R1（671B）采样约 8 个 CoT 响应。报告合计约 160 万个样本、1,000 万条 rollout。数学验证工具检查可验证答案；由于它可能把复杂的正确解判错，GPT-4o-mini 会复核最初标为错误的 rollout。记录还带有领域、难度和重复模式标签。精确混合权重、样本级来源、提示、各步保留量与许可证均为 unknown。

中训练使用完整构造集，并通过拒绝采样保留正确响应；设置为 16K packing 序列、batch size 128、learning rate 1e-5、5 个 epoch 和 0.1 warmup。SFT 选择数量未披露、难度高于大学水平的紧凑子集，使用 20K non-packing 序列，并沿用报告中的相同 batch、学习率、epoch 与 warmup 设置。DPO 使用高中及以上难度问题的正确/错误配对，序列长度 16K、learning rate 5e-7、训练 1 个 epoch；偏好对数量与筛选产率未报告。

RL 部分讨论 GRPO，并报告三类稳定性问题：同组正奖励响应长度约在 12K 至 20K token 之间波动、组内奖励一致时梯度消失，以及训练探索温度与评测温度不匹配。其配方会对多个候选提示反复采样，只保留响应长度相对一致的提示；对困难提示过采样，保留全部正样本并随机抽取等量负样本；过滤组准确率高于示例阈值 50% 的过易提示；并在前半程把温度从 1.0 线性降到 0.6。RL 使用 learning rate 5e-7 和 25K 序列。最终 RL 算法代码、rollout 组大小、提示池、verifier 实现与其余优化设置均未发布。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official arXiv paper and HTML text support the four stages, named source table, approximately eight generated rollouts per missing-trace question, 10M-rollout/1.6M-sample aggregate, math-tool verification, GPT-4o-mini rechecking, preference construction, RL stabilization measures, and training settings. The paper's staged table reports AIME 2024 / MATH-500 / GPQA Diamond moving from 10.0 / 71.8 / 36.9 for Phi-4-Mini to 30.0 / 82.9 / 42.6 after mid-training, 43.3 / 89.3 / 48.3 after SFT, 50.0 / 93.6 / 49.0 after DPO, and 57.5 / 94.6 / 52.0 after RL. These are author-reported behavior measurements under the stated evaluation protocol, not independent evidence that the data or verifier is high quality.

The official Hugging Face repository releases the 3.8B model weights under MIT and provides a model card, inference files, and the report PDF. Its model card reports 128K context, 128 H100-80G GPUs, two days of training, 150B training tokens, and approximately 30B tokens of retained math content; those figures are not all reconciled with stage-level counts in the paper. The later official Data Summary confirms public and synthetic data use, February 2025 acquisition, and cleaning.

An audit-relevant inconsistency remains. The paper states that existing reasoning annotations are directly reused and DeepSeek-R1 generates answers only where trajectories are absent. The model card and Data Summary instead describe the training data as exclusively synthetic mathematical content generated by DeepSeek-R1. No released item manifest resolves this difference. The official repository does not contain the 10M rollouts, selected SFT subset, preference pairs, RL pool, training code, verifier code, or decontamination report.

官方 arXiv 论文与 HTML 正文支撑以下事实：四个训练阶段、具名来源表、每个缺轨迹问题约 8 个生成 rollout、约 1,000 万 rollout/160 万样本总量、数学工具验证、GPT-4o-mini 复核、偏好构造、RL 稳定化措施及训练设置。论文的分阶段表报告 AIME 2024 / MATH-500 / GPQA Diamond：Phi-4-Mini 为 10.0 / 71.8 / 36.9；中训练后为 30.0 / 82.9 / 42.6；SFT 后为 43.3 / 89.3 / 48.3；DPO 后为 50.0 / 93.6 / 49.0；RL 后为 57.5 / 94.6 / 52.0。这些是作者在所述评测协议下报告的模型行为测量，不是数据或 verifier 高质量的独立证据。

官方 Hugging Face 仓库以 MIT 许可证发布 38 亿参数模型权重，并提供模型卡、推理文件和报告 PDF。模型卡报告 128K 上下文、128 张 H100-80G、2 天训练、1,500 亿训练 token，以及约 300 亿 token 的保留数学内容；这些数字并未全部与论文各阶段计数对齐。后续官方 Data Summary确认使用公开数据和合成数据、采集时间为 2025 年 2 月，并执行过清洗。

仍有一处值得审计的口径差异：论文称直接复用来源中已有的推理标注，只在缺少轨迹时由 DeepSeek-R1 生成答案；模型卡与 Data Summary 则把训练数据描述为全部由 DeepSeek-R1 生成的合成数学内容。没有公开样本清单可以化解这一差异。官方仓库也不包含 1,000 万条 rollout、筛选后的 SFT 子集、偏好对、RL 数据池、训练代码、verifier 代码或去污染报告。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The individual ingredients are established: long-CoT distillation, rejection sampling, DPO, GRPO-style RLVR, and answer checking all predate this report. The report's direction signal is their staged coordination for a 3.8B model and the explicit reuse of rejected rollouts as preference negatives. It also links concrete data operations to stages: full-set packed mid-training, a harder compact SFT subset, high-school-or-harder correct/incorrect DPO pairs, then fresh answer-rewarded RL groups.

A second contribution is diagnostic rather than algorithmic. The paper records small-model RL failure surfaces—12K-20K within-group response-length variation, uniform-reward groups, and temperature mismatch—and associates each with a data or sampling intervention. This makes the report more useful to a disclosure ledger than a result-only model announcement.

What is not new or established must remain explicit. Benchmark gains do not validate source rights, trace correctness, verifier reliability, or contamination control. The paper does not release a reusable dataset, preference manifest, reward implementation, or end-to-end training stack, and the later official source-description mismatch weakens item-level provenance claims.

各个组成部分本身并非首次出现：长 CoT 蒸馏、拒绝采样、DPO、GRPO 式 RLVR 与答案检查都早于本报告。其方向信号在于把这些环节按阶段协调到一个 38 亿参数模型上，并明确把被拒 rollout 复用为偏好负样本。报告还把具体数据操作映射到训练阶段：完整集合的 packing 中训练、更难的紧凑 SFT 子集、高中及以上难度的正确/错误 DPO 配对，以及随后使用新鲜采样组的答案奖励 RL。

第二项贡献偏向诊断而非新算法。论文记录了小模型 RL 的故障面：组内响应长度在 12K 至 20K token 之间波动、组内奖励完全一致、训练与评测温度不匹配，并为每类问题对应一种数据或采样干预。这使该报告对数据披露账本的价值高于仅公布结果的模型公告。

仍须明确哪些内容既非新贡献也未被证明：基准增益不能验证来源权利、轨迹正确性、verifier 可靠性或污染控制。论文没有发布可复用数据集、偏好清单、奖励实现或端到端训练栈；后续官方材料在来源描述上的差异，也削弱了样本级谱系主张。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Training-data disclosure stops at named source classes and aggregate scale. Several in-house seeds are undisclosed; public-source mixture weights, per-source retained counts, item IDs, collection dates, exact SFT and DPO subset sizes, RL prompt and rollout counts, split membership, and an integrated license ledger are absent. No contamination or benchmark-overlap audit is provided. The paper's direct-reuse description and the later model card's exclusively-DeepSeek-R1 description cannot both serve as a complete item-level provenance account without a manifest.

The feedback layer is not reproducible. The math verifier and its parser are not released, even though the paper acknowledges false negatives. GPT-4o-mini is a proprietary dependency for rechecking and difficulty filtering; prompts, model snapshot, calibration, disagreement rates, and adjudication rules are unknown. Final-answer reward does not establish the validity of intermediate reasoning and can be vulnerable to answer-format parsing or reward exploitation. DPO pair statistics and the complete RL algorithm configuration are also missing.

The experiments are limited to mathematical reasoning benchmarks and do not establish transfer to other domains, languages, or high-stakes uses. The staged ablation is informative but does not isolate data composition from optimization, compute, and sampling changes. The official release provides model weights and inference-oriented assets, not the training corpus, stage manifests, training code, verifier, or replayable environment; independent reproduction of the reported pipeline is therefore not currently possible.

训练数据披露停留在具名来源类别和总规模。若干内部种子未公开；公开来源混合权重、各来源保留量、样本 ID、采集日期、精确 SFT/DPO 子集规模、RL 提示与 rollout 数、切分成员以及统一许可证账本均缺失。官方材料也没有给出去污染或基准重叠审计。在没有样本清单时，论文“直接复用已有标注”的描述与后续模型卡“全部由 DeepSeek-R1 生成”的描述都不能单独构成完整样本级谱系。

反馈层不可复现。数学 verifier 及其解析器没有发布，尽管论文承认它会产生假阴性。GPT-4o-mini 是用于复核和难度过滤的专有依赖，其提示、模型快照、校准、分歧率和裁决规则均为 unknown。最终答案奖励不能证明中间推导有效，还可能受到答案格式解析或奖励利用的影响。DPO 偏好对统计和完整 RL 算法配置同样缺失。

实验仅覆盖数学推理基准，不能证明可迁移到其他领域、语言或高风险用途。分阶段消融有参考价值，但没有把数据组成与优化、算力和采样变化完全隔离。官方发布的是模型权重和面向推理的资产，而不是训练语料、阶段清单、训练代码、verifier 或可回放环境；因此目前无法独立复现报告中的完整流水线。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Within the Frontier Reports and Data Disclosure Ledger track, this Card supports a stage-by-stage comparison of small-model reasoning releases. Curators can ask the same questions across reports: Which questions and traces enter mid-training? Which records survive verification? How is the SFT subset selected? Are rejected generations retained as preference evidence? Is RL feedback executable, judge-mediated, or mixed? Which counts and artifacts are actually released?

Phi-4-Mini-Reasoning supports precise labels. It describes trace distillation, answer-outcome rejection sampling, correct-over-incorrect preference learning, and answer-level RLVR. It also discloses several sequence lengths, learning rates, evaluation settings, and sampling interventions. It does not justify labels such as open training data, process-supervised reasoning, fully programmatic verification, released reward stack, contamination-audited corpus, or reproducible end-to-end recipe.

The paper is especially useful for separating three evidence layers: reported training construction, released model artifacts, and reported benchmark behavior. The 10M rollouts and stage subsets belong to the first layer but are unavailable; the Hugging Face weights belong to the second; benchmark and ablation numbers belong to the third. Keeping these layers distinct prevents an open-weight model or a strong score from being misread as an open or validated data pipeline.

在“前沿报告与数据披露账本”轨道中，这张 Card 可用于逐阶段比较小模型推理发布。策展者可以对不同报告提出同一组问题：哪些问题与轨迹进入中训练？哪些记录通过验证？SFT 子集如何选择？被拒生成是否作为偏好证据保留？RL 反馈是可执行、经裁判中介，还是混合式？哪些计数与产物真正公开？

Phi-4-Mini-Reasoning 可以被精确归类。它描述了轨迹蒸馏、按答案结果拒绝采样、正确相对错误的偏好学习，以及答案级 RLVR；还披露若干序列长度、学习率、评测设置与采样干预。但它不足以支持“训练数据开放”“过程监督推理”“完全程序化验证”“奖励栈已发布”“语料经过污染审计”或“端到端配方可复现”等标签。

该论文特别适合区分三层证据：报告中的训练构造、实际发布的模型资产，以及报告中的基准行为。1,000 万条 rollout 与各阶段子集属于第一层，但不可得；Hugging Face 权重属于第二层；基准和消融数字属于第三层。保持三者分离，可以避免把开放权重或高分误读为开放且已经验证的数据流水线。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Sections 3.1-3.4 as four different data contracts: packed accepted traces, a harder SFT subset, correct/incorrect DPO pairs, and fresh answer-rewarded RL groups.
  • Use Section 4 and Table 2 to record the eight named public resources, in-house seeds, approximately eight generated rollouts per missing-trace question, and the 10M-rollout/1.6M-sample aggregate.
  • Inspect the verifier boundary: a math tool performs the first check, GPT-4o-mini rechecks initial negatives, and neither implementation nor error analysis is released.
  • Read the RL stability discussion with the training settings; prompt-length filtering, positive/negative rebalancing, and temperature annealing change the sampling distribution as well as optimization.
  • Compare the paper with the official model card and Data Summary. Preserve their source-provenance mismatch, and count released weights separately from unreleased training data and verifier assets.

• 把第 3.1 至 3.4 节视为四种不同的数据合同：packing 的正确轨迹、更难的 SFT 子集、正确/错误 DPO 偏好对，以及使用答案奖励的新鲜 RL 采样组。
  • 用第 4 节与表 2 记录八个具名公开资源、内部种子、每个缺轨迹问题约 8 个生成 rollout，以及约 1,000 万 rollout/160 万样本总量。
  • 检查 verifier 边界：数学工具执行初次检查，GPT-4o-mini 复核最初的负例，但两者实现与误差分析均未发布。
  • 把 RL 稳定性讨论与训练设置一起阅读；提示长度过滤、正负样本再平衡和温度退火不仅改变优化，也改变采样分布。
  • 对照论文、官方模型卡与 Data Summary，保留其来源谱系口径差异，并把已发布权重与未发布训练数据、verifier 资产分开计数。
